name: aspergillum-bedrock-addon
description: A production-grade liturgical aspergillum and aspersorium Add-On for Minecraft Bedrock Edition.

scripts.build: npm run generate:assets && npm run build:script && npm run validate
scripts.validate: node tools/validate.mjs && node tools/validate-animation-choreography.mjs && node tools/validate-vfx.mjs && node tools/validate-release-readiness.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && node tools/package.mjs && npm run validate:mcaddon
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate:docs && npm run build
